info.description: Gets information about a composite entity in a version of the application.
info.title: LUIS Authoring Client

requests.description: Lists all of the user's applications.
requests.name: GET /apps/
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Creates a new LUIS app.
requests.name: POST /apps/
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Gets the endpoint URLs for the prebuilt Cortana applications.
requests.name: GET /apps/assistants
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Gets a list of supported cultures. Cultures are equivalent to the written language and locale. For example,"en-us" represents the U.S. variation of English.
requests.name: GET /apps/cultures
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Gets all the available custom prebuilt domains for all cultures.
requests.name: GET /apps/customprebuiltdomains
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Adds a prebuilt domain along with its intent and entity models as a new application.
requests.name: POST /apps/customprebuiltdomains
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Gets all the available prebuilt domains for a specific culture.
requests.name: GET /apps/customprebuiltdomains/{culture}
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets the available application domains.
requests.name: GET /apps/domains
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Imports an application to LUIS, the application's structure is included in the request body.
requests.name: POST /apps/import
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Gets the application available usage scenarios.
requests.name: GET /apps/usagescenarios
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Deletes an application.
requests.name: DELETE /apps/{appId}
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets the application info.
requests.name: GET /apps/{appId}
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates the name or description of the application.
requests.name: PUT /apps/{appId}
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Removes assigned Azure account from the application.
requests.name: apps - Removes an assigned LUIS Azure account from an application
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: apps - Removes an assigned LUIS Azure account from an application

requests.description: Gets the LUIS Azure accounts assigned to the application for the user using his ARM token.
requests.name: apps - Get LUIS Azure accounts assigned to the application
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: apps - Get LUIS Azure accounts assigned to the application

requests.description: Assigns an Azure account to the application.
requests.name: apps - Assign a LUIS Azure account to an application
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: apps - Assign a LUIS Azure account to an application

requests.description: Returns the available endpoint deployment regions and URLs.
requests.name: GET /apps/{appId}/endpoints
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Removes a user from the allowed list of users to access this LUIS application. Users are removed using their email address.
requests.name: DELETE /apps/{appId}/permissions
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets the list of user emails that have permissions to access your application.
requests.name: GET /apps/{appId}/permissions
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Adds a user to the allowed list of users to access this LUIS application. Users are added using their email address.
requests.name: POST /apps/{appId}/permissions
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Replaces the current user access list with the new list sent in the body. If an empty list is sent, all access to other users will be removed.
requests.name: PUT /apps/{appId}/permissions
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Publishes a specific version of the application.
requests.name: POST /apps/{appId}/publish
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get the application publish settings including 'UseAllTrainingData'.
requests.name: GET /apps/{appId}/publishsettings
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates the application publish settings including 'UseAllTrainingData'.
requests.name: PUT /apps/{appId}/publishsettings
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets the logs of the past month's endpoint queries for the application.
requests.name: GET /apps/{appId}/querylogs
requests.note: Replace {{LUIS_AUTHORING_CLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates the application settings including 'UseAllTrainingData'.
